title: gravitas.catalog-curation/1
description: The maintainers' record of which declarative extensions the catalog serves (catalog/curation.json): the catalog's version, and for each accepted extension its directory under extensions/ and the review it passed, with the date and the checks. tools/catalog.mjs reads it with no check of its own, so this schema is the only statement of its shape; `catalog check` (CATALOG.md) holds each extension it names to the catalog's rules. Nothing refuses a field it does not know, so neither does this schema. FORMATS.md lists it.

history.description: Carried into the catalog entry's history as written.
